title: Raw bioimpedance frequency dispersion gave an uncertain, small hemoglobin prediction gain across two NHANES cycles
abstract: In complete-case NHANES2001–2002 adults20–49 (n1784), adding log(R5/R200) to a model trained in NHANES1999–2000 (n1507) improved weighted hemoglobin MSE by 0.004201(g/dL)^2; joint stratum-PSU-refit95% interval[-0.008048,0.012900] crosses zero. This does not establish reliable predictive gain beyond 50kHz phase angle, impedance index and covariates.
